standard.summary: absolute=同维 cosine/L2；relational=Gram（维可不齐，latent_identity 推荐）。默认 absolute。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.relational: 用关系/Gram 对齐，维可以不对齐。

standard_en.summary: absolute = same-dimension cosine/L2; relational = Gram (the dimensions need not match, recommended with latent_identity). Default absolute.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.relational: Aligns by relations/Gram, so the dimensions need not match.

advanced.principle: absolute=同维 cosine/L2；relational=Gram（维可不齐，latent_identity 推荐）。默认 absolute。

advanced_en.principle: absolute = same-dimension cosine/L2; relational = Gram (dimensions need not match; recommended with latent_identity). Default absolute.
